cat > /root/schema-dag-extraction/scripts/auto_start_exp012_awq.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "[$(date)] Waiting for AWQ model download to complete..."

# Wait for huggingface-cli download process (PID 284997) to finish
while ps -p 284997 -o pid= > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    INCOMPLETE=$(find /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/llama-3.1-70b-instruct-awq-int4/.cache/huggingface/download/ -name "*.incomplete" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    echo "[$(date)] Download in progress... $INCOMPLETE incomplete files remaining"
    sleep 60
done

echo "[$(date)] Download process finished. Verifying model..."

# Verify all 9 shards exist
SHARD_COUNT=$(find /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/llama-3.1-70b-instruct-awq-int4/ -maxdepth 1 -name "model-*.safetensors" -type f | wc -l)
if [ "$SHARD_COUNT" -ne 9 ]; then
    echo "[$(date)] ERROR: Expected 9 shards, found $SHARD_COUNT. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[$(date)] All 9 shards verified. Starting exp-012 AWQ..."
bash /root/schema-dag-extraction/scripts/run_exp012_llama_awq.sh
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/schema-dag-extraction/scripts/auto_start_exp012_awq.sh
echo "AUTO_SCRIPT_CREATED"
